name: agentex-copilot
description: Agentic QA for GitHub Copilot — skip the manual grind. AgenTeX plans and runs your tests for you (human-in-the-loop or fully autonomous) with structured evidence and a consolidated defect report, driving a real browser via Playwright. Test steps can call your APIs and query your database from a user-defined integration catalog, and ask your project's knowledge base a question mid-run. Ported from AgenTeX v0.19.0 (github.com/MhmdElGazzar/agentex), a Claude Code plugin.
_readme: This file is descriptive metadata only — GitHub Copilot has no plugin-manifest/install mechanism that reads it. The real integration points are AGENTS.md, agents/*.agent.md, and .github/copilot-instructions.md; see README.md and DEPLOYMENT.md.
